subject: Learning Methods
title: The Sentence Method
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: The Sentence Method.

hook.text: Each new idea gets its own numbered line. No hierarchy, no columns. Just a clean list of ideas in the order they.

buildup.text: The sentence method writes one complete thought per line. Simple to learn and fast to execute in real-time lectures.

discovery.text: It captures the flow of a lecture without requiring you to process structure in the moment. Organization comes later.

twist.text: The trade-off: without hierarchy, review is harder. A list of 50 sentences needs post-processing to become useful.

climax.text: Use the sentence method for fast-paced lectures. After class, organize the sentences into clusters or an outline.

punchline.text: Capture fast now. Organize later. Don't lose the moment.

quiz.question: What is the main trade-off of the sentence method?
options: It is too slow for real-time notes
It captures well in the moment but requires post-processing to organize
It only works for science lectures
